The plate looks like a side plate, about 20 cm across. It is roughly 215 px wide in the image, so about 10.8 px per cm.

The main item is a pile of oatmeal or granola-like clusters with a berry sauce. It covers about 120 px by 100 px, which is roughly 11 cm by 9 cm. That is a footprint of about 80 cm², and with a height of about 3 cm the volume is roughly 150–200 cm³ after allowing for air. A weight of about 110 g seems reasonable for something that looks like oats with almond flakes, such as overnight oats or a muesli mix. I'll treat it as cooked oatmeal with almonds at about 120 kcal/100 g.

The dark red streaks are berry sauce or jam. There is only a small amount, so I'll put it at about 15 g and 150 kcal/100 g.

At the edge of the plate there is a banana slice. It is about 4 cm across and 1.5 cm thick, so about 15 g. A banana is about 89 kcal/100 g.
